scope: Generic native Flock recording and algebra exporters only. The historical Stage3ArtifactV1 reconstruction, statement wrapper, root-slot mapping, proof codec, and terminal acceptance API are excluded.

Read-only reference. Not imported; native root-discharge callbacks are not closed-relation terminal acceptance.

semantic_changes: Public-slot constants come from the approved CompiledExec template, not mutation probes against one proof's public vector.
Exec-only strict decoding and native verification are owned by ixby-flock; no Stage 2 artifact or legacy fallback is admitted.
Generic circuit binding constrains S = H4(P,B,I,O), public Q = H5(P,B,O), and the exact approved Flock statement prefix. It reconstructs the public vector from fixed words and computed S.
Independent proof-free symbolic wiring and Boolean PIOP compilers reconstruct exact DAGs and PCS claim wires from CompiledExec; native replay must match them structurally.

Proof-free merged PCS, multipoint/anchor, inner Ligerito, and complete main transcript operation-tree compilers pin all fixed dimensions, addresses, labels, forks/merges, private slots, and PoW policies; no verifier/prover or witness value is used to construct them.

Proof-free auxiliary matrix/structure/jagged fold compilation and pure operation-tree-to-BLAKE3 lowering cover both complete transcripts without hash evaluation or dummy values. Exact native topology comparison excludes only concrete CV/message witness columns, whose validity remains a circuit obligation.

compile_exec_replay accepts only approved CompiledExec setup and returns an immutable borrowed topology with fourteen distinct component identities. The same compiled object is reused for different guests and branch outcomes; no proof-dependent shape is adopted as key material.

Witness replay and its proof-free topology compiler are not terminal acceptance certificates. The later setup-only R1CS emitter is tracked separately below; complete key preprocessing and proving remain unfinished.

Initial M6 prototype code compiles exact setup-owned sparse root tables to bounded decision diagrams, including structure constant-pin plane 5 and the complete jagged layout. A neutral F128 R1CS gadget evaluates their MLEs without value hints. Its initial component-only measurements precede the separate closed composition below; the diagnostic root-conditional path is preserved.

The exact all-table native differential, one actual-table materialized R1CS, and bounded variable-order/cofactor-XOR experiments are recorded separately in census/exec-fixed-root-table-prototype-v0.json with source hashes. Most rewrites grow or fail their resource bounds and are not adopted by default. No Stage 3 table, profile, key, or transcript was changed.

The separate structural BLAKE3 prototype ports the pinned Option-F linear row formulas into shared XOR maps. It accepts them only after exhaustive coefficient equality with both approved registry matrices. The original formula-source hash was recorded before the port; provenance, neutral-gadget tests, native differentials, and complete component-only R1CS/PLONK censuses are retained in census/exec-structural-blake3-root-v0.json. Neither the root-conditional acceptance relation nor any Stage 3 table/profile/key/transcript is changed.

The initial compile_exec_root_closure derived a complete immutable ordered set from the approved replay: two coefficient-checked BLAKE3 linear programs, 44 other matrix diagrams, and exact structure/jagged diagrams. No guest, point, value, statement, or proof is a compilation input. It temporarily builds all diagrams, with global limits including the discarded BLAKE3 diagrams, then runs separately bounded exact linear validation. The later structure-basis replacement is recorded below.

constrain_exec_root_closed shares the complete replay body with the diagnostic root-conditional entry point, preserving the latter's public allocation/emission order. At every family-binding site it computes exact table evaluations from existing constrained fold point wires and equates existing claims; no new root witness or native discharge callback is used. Its only public input is the externally expected two-limb Q. The later setup-only matrix emitter uses this same composition; no terminal key or complete proof has been generated.

A fallible matrix-free R1CS observer latches the first resource/error refusal; subsequent emissions do no work, allocations and both finish methods fail. A separate PLONK prefix type and closed-census outcome distinguish refused prefixes from complete counts/digests. The bounded closed census caps required rows at the supported FFLONK size-4n FFT geometry, including public/blinding reservations. It is not host-resource or setup approval.

Materialized synthetic root-binding tests cover both program types, all families, every changed claim bit, and missing/duplicate/reordered/malformed identities. Native setup compiles all tables twice before three different guest/outcome proofs; all 48 roots match the independent native folds. Native comparisons and bounded-prefix tests are not a full closed-relation satisfying-assignment check or FFLONK proof.

The initial bounded full-emission test rejected the closed encoding at 643831813 R1CS constraints and 1073741821 PLONK constraint rows: with two public and two blinding rows, the prefix crosses the supported 2^30 domain. It stops before completing the relation and returns no full R1CS projection digest/census. Exact source hashes, commands, 1245.361-second emission duration, and process-memory scope are retained in census/exec-root-closed-admission-v0.json. No full closed-relation materialization, SRS, terminal key or proof was produced.

The subsequent proof-free R1CS emitter takes only immutable CompiledExecRootClosure and resource limits. It derives all source-slot geometry from approved blueprints, invokes the same entire closed composition with non-witness scratch, and cannot export an assignment. No guest, commitment, expected Q, statement, proof or native replay is a setup input. Public Q and private B/I/O remain circuit variables.

Construction-time shape mode suppresses only redundant native-value diagnostics; actual equalities, inverse nonzero constraints, transcript/PoW, PCS/Merkle, all folds and exact root evaluations remain. Structural validation and ordinary witness diagnostics are preserved. Matrix/observer limits are sticky; source payload bounds precede allocation and all emitter errors must be propagated. Logical source payload is not a peak-memory admission.

Materialized component matrices agree between setup-only emission and multiple valid assignments, with assertion/inverse/challenge/statement/fold/root/CAP mutations rejected by the same matrices. The real-Exec regression emits a 4096-constraint exact setup prefix before any guest/proof and compares it with three native executions; this is not a full R1CS identity. The proof-free whole-relation census is separately bounded by the supported FFLONK domain. No complete key or terminal proof is claimed.

The proof-free whole-relation run returned RejectedBudget after 1240.765 seconds of emission, with no guest/Flock proof constructed. Its 643831813 R1CS constraints, 1073741821 PLONK rows and 429910008 auxiliary wires exactly match the recorded native prefix cutoff, not a complete matrix digest. The separate census/exec-proof-free-root-closed-emission-v0.json records all 20 changed Rust source hashes, 200 ordinary tests, 11 debug setup tests, the real three-execution regression, bounds and memory/timing scope. Full geometry remains oversized; no complete closed R1CS, assignment, key or proof was generated.

The exact cofactor-basis compiler performs bounded GF(2) elimination on source Shannon-cofactor pairs and retains fixed low/slope coefficient programs. It has no witness, arbitrary-layer or sampled-value admission API. Skipped coordinates, all 128 field-coefficient bits and exact resource exhaustion have ordinary tests; materialized point/output/root mutation tests preserve proof-free/assigned matrix equality. The paired actual structure component drops from 57687119 to 15998468 R1CS constraints and from 92024156 to 21653222 PLONK rows. The measured compiler now adopts this representation only for structure, with an explicit structure_basis budget and no fallback; other programs and every Stage 3 matrix/profile/key/transcript stay unchanged.

census/exec-cofactor-root-basis-v0.json records all 13 changed Rust source hashes, 207 ordinary tests, 11 debug tests, 44 successful bounded candidate programs and four refusals, the larger-budget failed alternatives, complete paired structure-component projections, and the updated real three-execution root regression. Its new composition/table identities are explicit program identities, not terminal keys. The earlier matrix-stage domain refusal precedes structure evaluation; component savings do not produce a new complete closed census, materialized relation or proof.
